# Load data

```{r}
esviritu_human <- fread(here("data", "Human_data.tsv"))

sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")

sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  mutate(Year_cat = ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", sample_ID),

```

```{r}
esviritu_human_ANI90 <- esviritu_human %>%
  filter(avg_read_identity >=0.90)
```

## Function for RPKMF value calculation (at taxa level)

```{r}
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  #tidyr
  RPKMF_df_wide <-pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_ID,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(RPKMF_df_wide)
}
```

```{r}
RPKMF_df(esviritu_human, "species")[1:5,1:5]
```
## Function to calculate species count (or other taxa)

```{r}
summarize_tax_levels <- function(data){
  data %>%
    group_by(sample_ID) %>%
    summarize(phylums=n_distinct(phylum),
              classes=n_distinct(tclass),
              orders=n_distinct(order),
              families=n_distinct(family),
              genera=n_distinct(genus),
              species=n_distinct(species),
              subspecies=n_distinct(subspecies),
              .groups="drop")
}
```

```{r}
summarize_tax_levels(esviritu_human)$species
```


## Alpha diversity calculations

```{r}
#calculate alpha diversity metrics for species level data

alpha_diveristy_calc <- function(data){
  
  species_df <- RPKMF_df(data, "species")
  
  #calculate shannon index
  adiv <- data.frame(sample_ID=colnames(species_df[,-1]),
                  shannon_index = diversity(x=t(species_df[,-1]), 
                                            index="shannon",
                                            equalize.groups = FALSE),
                  simpson_index_inv = diversity(x=t(species_df[,-1]), 
                                            index="invsimpson",
                                            equalize.groups = FALSE),
                  simpson_index = diversity(x=t(species_df[,-1]), 
                                            index="simpson",
                                            equalize.groups = FALSE),
                  species_count = summarize_tax_levels(data)$species)
                  #chao1 = chao1(t(species_df[,-1]), taxa.row = FALSE))
  
  
  #add metadata to alpha diversity 
  adiv <-  merge(adiv, 
                 sample_metadata[,c("sample_ID", "City", "Month_chr", "Date", 
                                    "Season", "Season_year", "reads_in_sample",
                                    "Year_cat")],
                  by="sample_ID")


  return(adiv)
  
}

alpha_div_human <- alpha_diveristy_calc(esviritu_human)
alpha_div_human_ANI90 <- alpha_diveristy_calc(esviritu_human_ANI90)
```

## Alpha diversity per city at species level

```{r}
fonts <- theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14, face = "bold", hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
plot_adiv_by_city <- function(adiv_data, variable){
  pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")[c(1,6)]
  
  plot <- ggplot(data=adiv_data, aes(x=City, y=!!sym(variable), fill=Year_cat)) +
    geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge())+
    guides(fill=guide_legend(title="")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal)+
    ylab("") +
    theme_bw() +
    fonts
  
  return(plot)
}
```

```{r}
save_adiv_plot <- function(data, variable, y_lab, filtered=FALSE, mode="plot"){

  pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")[c(1,6)]
  
  plot <- ggplot(data=data, aes(x=City, y=!!sym(variable), fill=Year_cat)) +
    geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge())+
    guides(fill=guide_legend(title="")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal)+
    ylab("") +
    theme_bw() +
    fonts +
    labs(y=paste(y_lab))
  
    if(filtered==FALSE){
      plot_name <- paste0("adiv_", variable, "_by_city_years.jpg")
    } else{
      plot_name <- paste0("adiv_", variable, "_by_city_years_ANI90.jpg")
    }
  
  if (mode=="plot"){
    return(plot)
  } else{
    ggsave(plot, 
       file = here("outputs/Figures/Diversity_metrics",plot_name), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)
  }
  
}

save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human, "shannon_index", "Shannon index", mode="plot")
save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human_ANI90, "shannon_index", "Shannon index",
               filtered=TRUE, mode="plot")

save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human, "simpson_index_inv", "Simpson index (1/D)", mode="plot")
save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human_ANI90, "simpson_index_inv","Simpson index (1/D)",
               filtered=TRUE, mode="plot")

save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human, "simpson_index", "Simpson index (1-D)", mode="plot")
save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human_ANI90, "simpson_index","Simpson index (1-D)",
              filtered=TRUE, mode="plot")

save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human, "species_count", "Detected species", mode="save")
save_adiv_plot(alpha_div_human_ANI90, "species_count", "Detected species",
              filtered=TRUE, mode="save")
```

## Test alpha diversity metrics with Wilcox-test

Test the difference in alpha diversity metrics 
--> all of them c("shannon_index", "simpson_index", "species_count))

```{r}
cities <- c("Helsinki", "Kuopio", "Oulu", "Tampere", "Turku")
city_pairs <- as.data.frame(combn(cities,2))

test_index <- c("shannon_index", "simpson_index", "simpson_index_inv", "species_count")


a_div_tests <- function(data){
  
  adiv_test_res <- data.frame(variable = c(),
                            City1 = c(),
                            City2 = c(),
                            statistic = c(),
                            p_value = c(),
                            q_value= c())
  
  for (index in test_index){
    tmp_res <- data.frame(
      variable = c(),
      City1 = c(),
      City2 = c(),
      statistic = c(),
      p_value = c())
    
    
    for(i in 1:10){
      city1_data <- data %>% filter(City==city_pairs[1,i])
      city2_data <- data %>% filter(City==city_pairs[2,i])

      res <- wilcox.test(city1_data[[index]], city2_data[[index]])
      
      new_res <- data.frame(variable = index,
                            City1 = city_pairs[1,i],
                            City2 = city_pairs[2,i],
                            statistic = res$statistic,
                            p_value = res$p.value)
      
      tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, new_res)

      #adiv_test_res <- rbind(adiv_test_res, new_res)

    }
    tmp_res$q_value <- p.adjust(tmp_res$p_value, method = "BH")
    adiv_test_res <- rbind(adiv_test_res, tmp_res)
  }
  
  return(adiv_test_res)
}

```

```{r}
a_div_tests(alpha_div_human) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```
